entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah... I, um, I need to return an item. It's a helmet I bought a little while ago. I just feel awful about it.
I can certainly look into that return for you. I'm sorry to hear there's an issue. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF-8675309. I've been a loyal customer for so long, and I was so excited for it, but... well, I really needed the money back for bills this month.
I understand completely. Thank you for that order number, I have your account pulled up. So I can best help, is it a technical fault with the helmet or more of a preference issue?

It's a preference, I guess. It’s the color. On the website, it looked like a deep crimson, but in person it's a very bright red. I just don't feel comfortable in it. The box is unopened, I haven't even taken the plastic off.
I see. It's important that you feel confident and that your gear doesn't distract you from your safety. Let me just review the return eligibility for this item.

Okay, great news. I see here that you received the helmet 19 days ago. Our policy for standard items like this allows for returns within 90 days. So, you are well within the window. I can go ahead and approve this return for a full refund immediately.
Oh, thank goodness. Really? That's such a huge relief. I was so worried I'd be stuck with it. Thank you, Sarah.

It's my pleasure. And I see here that you're a VIP member with us. As a thank you for your loyalty, once I process this, I'm also going to add a $20 credit to your account for a future purchase. I've just emailed you the pre-paid return shipping label.
Wow. You really didn't have to do that. That's incredibly kind. You've really turned my day around.

We're happy to do it. Just print that label, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed. Was there anything else I could help with today?
No, that was everything. Thank you so much again.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
